docstring: Builds a Red-Black BST index from (key, value) pairs and retrieves value for query key in O(log N).
signature: def rb_tree_search(items: list[tuple[int, str]], query_key: int) -> str | None:
ref_test:
def test_rb_search():
    items = [(10, "ten"), (20, "twenty"), (5, "five"), (15, "fifteen"), (30, "thirty")]
    assert rb_tree_search(items, 15) == "fifteen"
    assert rb_tree_search(items, 5) == "five"
    assert rb_tree_search(items, 99) is None
    assert rb_tree_search([], 10) is None
